visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoor city sidewalk during the day. A middle-aged man wearing a black graphic t-shirt and blue jeans stands beside a younger woman with short brown hair wearing a cropped denim jacket and light-colored jeans. The man suddenly embraces the woman in a dramatic hug while she laughs and smiles brightly. Motorbikes and cars are visible on the street behind them, along with shop signs and green foliage. (2) Interior of a traditional shaved ice shop. The man and woman are now wearing dark red aprons and blue caps over their clothes. They stand behind a stainless steel counter, interacting with an older woman wearing a floral headscarf and a face shield. The background features menus with prices, industrial kitchen equipment, and various containers of ingredients. (3) Preparation area inside the shop. The man and woman are focused on peeling large staro or sweet potatoes using handheld peelers into large metal mixing bowls. The lighting is bright and industrial. Close-up shots capture their hand movements and playful facial expressions as they struggle with the task. (4) Fast-paced montage showing the duo washing ingredients in a sink and interacting with the shop owner. The scene transitions to a promotional end screen with yellow and black text against the shop background.
